title: Understanding Non-Response Bias
text: Non-response bias occurs when the individuals who do not respond to a survey differ in meaningful ways from those who do respond. Consider how increasing the sample size and sending reminders might affect this bias.

title: Effect of Increasing Sample Size
text: Increasing the sample size from $$100$$ to $$200$$ can potentially reduce the non-response bias. Think about how a larger sample size might provide a more representative view of the population.

title: Impact of Reminder Emails
text: Sending reminder emails to those who did not open the initial email can increase the response rate. How might this affect the non-response bias?

title: Combining Both Strategies
text: Consider the combined effect of both increasing the sample size and sending reminder emails. How do these strategies together influence the non-response bias?

title: Comparing Bias Levels
text: Think about how the original survey's non-response bias compares to the updated survey's bias after implementing both strategies.

title: Final Conclusion on Bias
text: With both strategies implemented, the non-response bias of the updated survey is likely $$___$$ the non-response bias of the original survey.
